image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a maypole celebration. The central vertical pole is mostly obscured by the camera angle and the crowd, but numerous colorful ribbons (streamers) in red, orange, green, blue, and white extend from the top downwards. A dense crowd of people, including children and adults, are holding the ends of these streamers. The background shows trees and building structures, suggesting an outdoor festival setting.
